# BluetoothManager

> **File:** `services/system/BluetoothManager.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

Bluetooth state and actions over the default adapter (BlueZ via Quickshell.Bluetooth). Named BluetoothManager so it doesn't shadow Quickshell's `Bluetooth` singleton.

### Properties

- `adapter` (readonly var)
- `available` (readonly bool)
- `enabled` (readonly bool)
- `blocked` (readonly bool)
- `discovering` (readonly bool)
- `devices` (readonly var): Every device, by name.
- `pairedDevices` (readonly var)
- `discoveredDevices` (readonly var): Nearby devices found by a scan, in the order they turned up (so new ones join the end); unnamed ones (bare addresses) are noise
- `connectedDevices` (readonly var)

### Functions

- `setEnabled(on)`
- `toggleEnabled()`
- `setDiscovering(on)`
- `toggleDevice(device)`: Connected: disconnect.
- `forget(device)`
- `deviceLabel(device)`
- `deviceStatus(device)`
- `deviceIcon(device)`: Glyph for a device's freedesktop icon name (BlueZ "icon" property)
